description.label: Description
description.value:
You duck as small fragments pepper your face and scalp, a larger piece going so close that any headgear you are wearing gets caught.

Effects: A Hat, Leather Skullcap or Open Helm goes flying 1d10 yards. A Mail Coif robs you of one extra Wound as mail links dig into your scalp. An enclosed Helm gains you @Condition[Deafened] (2) as the sound of a fistful of leadshot thrown into a metal bucket assaults your ears! If you are bareheaded you lose a single point of Fellowship due to minor facial scarring. If you’re wearing Flexible layered armor only the outermost piece counts.
